block.description: The homelab provider enables standardized resource naming for homelab infrastructure.

name.description: The generated name following the pattern `<app>-<env>`, or just `<app>` for `prod`/`production` environments.

block.description: The `naming` data source generates standardized names following the pattern `<app>-<env>`. For production environments (`prod` or `production`), only the app name is used without an environment suffix. This enables consistent naming conventions across all homelab infrastructure resources.
